archive_holds.scope: Test cells pair three simultaneously withheld axes: geographical route families, original archive block, and exact traffic profiles.
archive_holds.geometry: The three Brindisi tracks overlap spatially and stay together. The Otranto files share exact legs and all stay in test; repeated legs and wind variants are paired sensitivity cases.
archive_holds.weather: Fit uses July 29 weather at training routes and generated synthetic scenarios. Original September 30 through October 1 forcing is test-only. September/October wind-bearing perturbations retain their archived weather magnitudes and dates.
archive_holds.validation: Fit and validation synthetic scenario IDs are disjoint. Validation reuses training traffic profiles but has no archived route or weather row. Reserve the existing synthetic test IDs from this study.
archive_holds.traffic: The held-out exact profiles are single-ship overtaking and mixed sharp-dropout. Components of these fixtures overlap mixed training vessel templates. The standalone encounter and sharp course/speed schedule are unseen; the long dropout schedule itself is shared.
archive_holds.exclusions: Naples and cross-block route cases are unused. Corfu long legs stay in the ledger and test; chart disks entirely blocked by GEBCO stay as preflight outcomes. Nine unavailable July Corfu variants remain represented without rollouts.
